remarks: Perched in a spectacular setting with sweeping panoramic views, south of the blvd, 13457 Cheltenham Drive is a truly unique residence offering exceptional space, privacy, and versatility across three expansive levels. Spanning approximately 4,539 square feet, this 4-bedroom, 4-bath home is highlighted by dramatic vaulted ceilings, generous living spaces, and walls of windows that capture the surrounding vistas and fill the interiors with natural light. Designed for both everyday living and entertaining, the home features multiple bonus and recreation rooms, a dedicated gym, wine cellar, and an abundance of flexible space to suit a variety of lifestyles.
